title: CircuitBreaker bound 5703/1250 via wire-graph cutwidth (validated-field family)

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total language L of proof.md section 1, decided at every length N by one fixed evaluator A. If N<16 output 0. Else k is the largest integer with 4^k<=N, t=2^k, m0=floor((N-t)/(t+1)), m=m0 if m0 is odd and m=m0-1 otherwise, l=N-t-m-t*m; if m<1 output 0. Bits 1..t define R(W)=W^t+sum_{v<t} x_{v+1}W^v and bits t+1..t+m define Q(Z)=Z^m+sum_{u<m} x_{t+u+1}Z^u over F_2; if R or Q fails the exact irreducibility test of proof.md (X^(2^d)=X mod P, and gcd(P,X^(2^d')-X)=1 for every divisor d' of d=deg P with d'<d) output 0. Otherwise the next t*m bits c_{u,v} (bit number t+m+v*m+u+1) give z=sum c_{u,v}Z^uW^v in the field E=(F_2[Z]/(Q))[W]/(R) with 2^(tm) elements, the last l bits are ignored, and the output is 1 iff z^e=1 for e=sum_{j=0}^{t-1} 2^(m*j). All t+m+l prefix and leftover bits are counted in N; R and Q are input, not advice.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1250","numerator":"5703"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1250","numerator":"5703"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"A runs in polynomial time on every input, so L is in P; L is in NP with witness bound W(N)=0 and the fixed verifier V that accepts (x,w) iff w is empty and A(x)=1. In the full pinned B2 model, with N the entire input length: for every real epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(L_N)>=(5703/1250-epsilon)*N for every integer N>=N_epsilon; equivalently, liminf over all integers N of C_B2(L_N)/N >= 5703/1250. Proof: proof.md, with circuit.md, cutwidth.md and krs.md.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
